initialExam.title: MP Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Madhya Pradesh Police Constable recruitment for GD, Radio, and other constable posts in MP state police.
initialExam.eligibility: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
initialExam.syllabus: GK, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, Hindi, Science, MP GK.
initialExam.examPattern: Online Test: 100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours. Physical Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → Physical Test → Medical → Document Verification → Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → SI → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit peb.mp.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform allowance, Pension
